query: SELECT s.id AS schedule_id, s.name AS schedule_name, s.wake_override AS "wake_override: ScheduleWakeOverride", w.mode AS "mode?: MachineWakeMode" FROM schedules s LEFT JOIN schedule_machine_wake w ON w.schedule_id = s.id AND w.machine_id = $1 WHERE (w.mode IS NOT NULL OR s.wake_override <> 'host_default') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedule_targets st JOIN agents a ON a.id = st.agent_id WHERE st.schedule_id = s.id AND a.machine_id = $1) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedule_repos sr JOIN repos r ON r.id = sr.repo_id JOIN repo_hosts h ON h.id = r.repo_host_id WHERE sr.schedule_id = s.id AND h.machine_id = $1) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedule_dependencies sd JOIN dependency_hosts d ON d.id = sd.dependency_host_id WHERE sd.schedule_id = s.id AND d.machine_id = $1)) ORDER BY s.name, s.id
